title: Checkpoint: Copy & Move
prompt: Implement `class Sentence` owning a `std::vector<std::string> words_` (rule of three/five, deep semantics). Provide `void add(std::string w)`, `std::size_t size() const`, and `std::string joined() const` returning words separated by single spaces. The test copies one Sentence, mutates the copy, and verifies independence, then moves a temporary into a vector.

tests.name: basic
independent
tests.hint: The copy must not share storage with the original.

tests.name: moved
tests.hint: A moved-from Sentence is empty but the moved-to keeps the words.
